answer: Witness-Linked Attestation Chains. Each identity must be co-signed by three prior agents who stake their own reputation pigment—a limited, non-transferable score earned only through verified work. A new agent needs co-signers who have each completed ten attested transactions; the signers lose score if the newcomer defects. In a shale-poor region, a haven of low-activity agents cannot bootstrap: attackers must farm real transaction history for three recruiters per fake identity, costing roughly thirty genuine verified interactions per Sybil.
